scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gulz/core && npm run build --workspace @gulz/cli && npm run build --workspace @gulz/website
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @gulz/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @gulz/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace @gulz/website
scripts.deploy:website: npm run build --workspace @gulz/website && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/website/wrangler.toml
scripts.build:cli: npm run build --workspace @gulz/core && npm run build --workspace @gulz/cli
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @gulz/core && npm run test --workspace @gulz/cli && npm run typecheck
